title: Federated learning method and related apparatus

pse.problem: Reduced convergence speed and precision of federated learning training due to non-uniform distribution of training datasets across terminal devices.
pse.solution_function: The method performs model training in a first network device using local training data from multiple terminal devices, sends the model gradient to a second network device for integration, resulting in a trained federated learning model that improves convergence and performance.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of first and second network devices, and multiple terminal devices storing local training data.
pse.solution_implementation: In the first network device, the local training data is preprocessed, cached, and a local data resource list is maintained. Model training is performed on the cached, preprocessed local training data to obtain a model gradient. The model gradient is then sent to the second network device.
pse.effect: Improved convergence speed and precision of federated learning training resulting in better performance.
